Container.Name: immich-dlna-proxy
Container.Overview: Exposes Immich albums and named people (photos only) as a DLNA MediaServer so Smart TVs can browse and display them without an extra app. Uses host networking because SSDP relies on UDP multicast, which does not traverse Docker's bridge network.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server (host:port), reachable from this container. With host networking, this is usually just your Unraid server's own IP and the Immich port.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich API key with album.read / asset.read / asset.download / person.read permissions. Create one under Immich > Account Settings > API Keys. Missing asset.download is the most common cause of albums/people browsing fine but every photo failing to load. Leave empty if you're setting Immich API Keys (below, under advanced settings) instead - exactly one of the two must be set.

Config.Name: Friendly Name
Config.Description: Name shown on TVs when browsing available DLNA servers.

Config.Name: Immich API Keys
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated list of Immich API keys, to expose more than one Immich user's library (e.g. one household sharing a single Immich server). Each account gets its own top-level DLNA folder named after it. Takes precedence over Immich API Key above when set.

Config.Name: Listen Address
Config.Description: host:port the HTTP part (description.xml, SOAP control, media streaming) binds to. Since networking is host mode, make sure this port is free on your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Device UUID
Config.Description: Optional: set a fixed UUID if you run more than one instance, so each has a stable identity. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

Config.Name: SSDP Interface
Config.Description: Optional: restrict SSDP discovery to a single network interface name (e.g. eth0). Leave empty to use all interfaces.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Host folder for the disk cache of photo bytes, so repeated views don't re-download from Immich. Survives container recreation.

Config.Name: Cache Max Size (MB)
Config.Description: Soft size budget for the cache folder in MB. Oldest-viewed photos are evicted first once exceeded.

Config.Name: Disable Cache
Config.Description: Set to true to disable disk caching entirely and always stream live from Immich.

Config.Name: Photo Source
Config.Description: auto: JPEG/PNG photos are served as the original, everything else (e.g. iPhone HEIC, which most TVs can't display) as Immich's JPEG preview. original: always the original file. preview: always the preview (faster, lower resolution). Clear the cache after changing.

Config.Name: Video Source
Config.Description: original: always the original video file. transcoded: the version Immich transcoded for playback (H.264 MP4 by default) - for TVs that can't play HEVC, MKV etc. Which videos Immich transcodes is set in Immich (Video Transcoding settings). Clear the cache after changing.

Config.Name: Extra Folders
Config.Description: Optional folders next to Albums/People/Timeline, comma-separated in the order to show them: favorites, onthisday, places (country/city from GPS data), random (100 random photos, reshuffled hourly). none for no extra folders.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone used for the On this day folder's notion of today, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Max Resolution
Config.Description: Downscale photos larger than this to fit, e.g. 1920x1080. Aspect ratio is preserved; smaller photos are untouched. Only JPEG/PNG are downscaled. Leave empty to always serve full resolution.

Config.Name: Media Fetch Concurrency
Config.Description: Max number of photos/thumbnails allowed to download from Immich at once. Extra requests queue for a free slot (giving up after 30s) instead of hitting Immich all at once - protects Immich when a TV rapidly scrolls through a large album. Must be a positive integer.

Config.Name: Listing Cache (seconds)
Config.Description: How long album/people/timeline listings are reused across browse requests, so a TV paging through a large album doesn't re-fetch the whole listing for every page. 0 always asks Immich live.

Config.Name: Timeline Grouping
Config.Description: none, year or month. year/month split the Timeline folder into one folder per year (and per month inside each year) instead of one long list.

Config.Name: Advertise IP
Config.Description: Optional: IPv4 address announced to TVs for discovery, if auto-detection picks the wrong one (e.g. a VLAN or bridge address). Leave empty to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set to true to log every photo/thumbnail request and other per-photo details.
